covered.title: Applicable standard identified
covered.detail: A main standard has been recommended for review.

covered.title: Safety requirement found
covered.detail: Safety scope was detected in the sample registry.

gaps.title: Test method not specified
gaps.why: Without a named test method, the basis for verifying performance remains unclear.
gaps.suggestion: LED lamps shall be tested in accordance with the applicable test method identified by the procuring authority.

gaps.title: Acceptance criteria missing
gaps.why: The tender does not state measurable acceptance criteria for the supplied product.
gaps.suggestion: Each supplied unit shall meet the acceptance criteria stated in the applicable procurement schedule.

gaps.title: “Good quality” is non-measurable
gaps.why: The phrase does not define a measurable acceptance criterion.
gaps.suggestion: Replace “good quality” with measurable performance and acceptance criteria approved by the procuring authority.

gaps.title: Reference to standard unresolved
gaps.why: The tender does not identify a specific standard or edition for this requirement.
gaps.suggestion: The procuring authority shall specify the applicable Indian Standard and edition after officer review.

gaps.title: Rating range not specified
gaps.why: No rating or operating range was included in the sample requirement.
gaps.suggestion: Specify the required rating and operating range in the procurement schedule.
